input: Create a shared grocery list app with my partner

gold.taskTitle: Build a Shared Grocery List App with Partner
gold.taskDescription: Create a functional shared grocery list application that both the user and their partner can access and use together.

questions.title: What platform should the app run on?
questions.description: Should the app be a mobile app (iOS/Android), a web app accessible by browser, or both?

questions.title: Are you building it or using an existing tool?
questions.description: Do you want to develop the app from scratch, or are you looking to set up and customize an existing app like AnyList, OurGroceries, or Google Keep?

questions.title: What is your technical skill level with coding?
questions.description: Are you a developer comfortable with code, a beginner, or someone with no coding experience at all?

questions.title: What does real-time syncing mean for your use case?
questions.description: Do both you and your partner need to see changes instantly as they happen, or is occasional syncing acceptable?

questions.title: What core features must the app include?
questions.description: Beyond adding and removing items, do you need features like categories, quantity tracking, recipe integration, or purchase history?

questions.title: What is your target deadline for having this ready?
questions.description: Do you need this working within days, weeks, or is this a longer-term project with no fixed deadline?

questions.title: Do you have a budget for tools, hosting, or services?
questions.description: Are you looking for a completely free solution, or are you open to paid platforms, subscriptions, or hosting costs?
